Each query below is a single attempt written from the page alone, and none were run. Four spots are guesses the page doesn't settle:
- **`trim`:** it isn't in the verb lists, so K11 removes spaces with `split " " | join ""`.
- **Numbers from strings:** K6 and K12 use `parseJson` to read numbers out of text.
- **`groupBy`:** I assumed it takes a quote key and answers a map of vectors, and that string keys become keywords. K2, K3, K10 and K11 rely on this.
- **Rounding:** `round` is used as `mul 100 | round | div 100`, because the page doesn't show a digits argument.

K1: ["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count
K2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer | * (* (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum)
K3: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " " | /1) | groupBy ~(/) | * count
K4: :r / | /dependencies | union (r | /devDependencies) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort
K5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
K6: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(/1 | ne "") | * (/1 | parseJson) | :a / | sum | div (a | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
K7: /services | :m / | keys * (:k / | m | at k | {:n (k | keyword) :port (at :port) :en (at :enabled)}) | filter ~(/en | eq true | and (/port | type | eq ::number)) | sort ~/port * (:o / | /n | append ":" | append (o | /port | print))
K8: /results | filter ~(if (at :email | type | eq ::string) ~(at :email | split "@" | last | lower | eq "example.com") ~(false)) | filter ~(/user/name/last | type | eq ::string) * (:o / | /user/name/last | append ", " | append (o | /user/name/first))
K9: filter ~(if (at :user | type | eq ::string) ~(/action | lower | eq "login") ~(false)) * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort
K10: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 100 | round | div 100)
K11: * (at :tags | coalesce "" | split " " | join "" | split ",") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | :m / | keys * (:k / | {:t (k | keyword) :n (m | at k | count)}) | sort ~([(/n | mul -1) /t]) | take 3 * /t
K12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | * split "|" | * (:r / | /1 | parseJson | mul (r | /2 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
K13: /services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(at :replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)
K14: * {:id /id :itemCount (at :items | coalesce [] | * /qty | sum)} | filter ~(/itemCount | gt 0) | sort ~([(/itemCount | mul -1) /id]) | take 3
